import pandas as pd, glob, os
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); print(os.path.basename(f), 'dup ids',d.flight_id.duplicated().sum(),'cancel types',d.cancelled.unique())

def calc(f):
 d=pd.read_csv(f)
 # unified date/times (UTC columns still valid elapsed time using UTC date)
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'
 scol='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'
 acol='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 d['sched']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[scol])
 d['actual']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[acol], errors='coerce')
 # handle actual after midnight by add day if clock parsed appears earlier than sched, but only when not canceled
 mask=(~d.cancelled.astype(bool)) & d.actual.notna() & (d.actual<d.sched)
 d.loc[mask,'actual'] += pd.Timedelta(days=1)
 d['delay']=(d.actual-d.sched).dt.total_seconds()/60
 busy=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 c=d[~d.cancelled.astype(bool)].groupby('route').agg(completed=('flight_id','size'), delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 c['rate']=c.delayed/c.completed
 eligible=c[c.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate','delayed'],ascending=False)
 print(os.path.basename(f), 'busy',busy.head(5).to_dict(), 'eligible',eligible.to_dict('index'))
 return busy.index[0], eligible.index[0]
res={os.path.basename(f).split('.')[0]:calc(f) for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv')}
print(res)

import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; scol='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; acol='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d['route']=[ '-'.join(sorted(x)) for x in zip(d.origin,d.dest)]
 d['s']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[scol]); d['a']=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]+' '+d[acol],errors='coerce')
 m=(~d.cancelled.astype(bool))&d.a.notna()&(d.a<d.s); d.loc[m,'a']+=pd.Timedelta(days=1); d['delay']=(d.a-d.s).dt.total_seconds()/60
 b=d.route.value_counts(); c=d[~d.cancelled.astype(bool)].groupby('route').agg(n=('flight_id','size'), delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum())); c['rate']=c.delayed/c.n; e=c[c.n>=20].sort_values(['rate','delayed'],ascending=False)
 out[os.path.basename(f)[:2]]={'busiest':b.index[0],'worst':e.index[0]}
 print(os.path.basename(f),b.head(2).to_dict(),e.head(3).to_dict('index'))
print(out)

events.notes: Grouped each carrier's Jan-Feb records by direction-independent, alphabetically ordered airport pair. Counted all scheduled records (including cancellations) for busiest; computed completed-flight delays using actual minus scheduled departure, handling after-midnight departures, and selected the highest rate among routes with at least 20 completed flights. Removed exact repeated flight_id records in B6, consistent with the documentation that flight_id is unique; AS UTC timestamps were compared on their UTC dates, which preserves elapsed departure delay.

import pandas as pd, glob, os
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:-4]; d=pd.read_csv(f)
 # normalize based on columns; data itself Jan-Feb likely filter date
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'
 sched='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; actual='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d[datecol]=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol])
 d=d[(d[datecol]>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01'))&(d[datecol]<pd.Timestamp('2025-03-01'))].copy()
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 busy=d.groupby('route').size(); busiest=busy[busy==busy.max()].index.tolist()
 # normalize bool in case
 d['cancelled']=d.cancelled.astype(bool)
 comp=d[~d.cancelled].copy()
 # clock diff, crossing midnight adjustment
 def diff(r):
  s=pd.to_datetime(r[sched],format='%H:%M'); a=pd.to_datetime(r[actual],format='%H:%M')
  x=(a-s).total_seconds()/60
  if x < -720: x+=1440
  elif x > 720: x-=1440
  return x
 comp['delay']=comp.apply(diff,axis=1)
 g=comp.groupby('route').agg(completed=('route','size'), delayed=('delay',lambda x:(x>15).sum()))
 g['rate']=g.delayed/g.completed
 elig=g[g.completed>=20]
 mx=elig.rate.max(); worst=elig[elig.rate==mx].index.tolist()
 print(c,'rows',len(d),'dupe ids',d.flight_id.duplicated().sum(),'busiest',busy[busy==busy.max()].to_dict(),'worst',elig.loc[worst,['completed','delayed','rate']].to_dict('index'))
 out[c]={'busiest':busiest,'worst':worst}
print(out)

import pandas as pd, glob, os
ans={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 c=os.path.basename(f)[:-4]; d=pd.read_csv(f).drop_duplicates('flight_id')
 datecol='date_utc' if 'date_utc' in d else 'date'; sc='sched_dep_utc' if 'sched_dep_utc' in d else 'sched_dep'; ac='actual_dep_utc' if 'actual_dep_utc' in d else 'actual_dep'
 d[datecol]=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]); d=d[(d[datecol].dt.year==2025)&(d[datecol].dt.month.isin([1,2]))].copy()
 d['route']=[ '-'.join(sorted((o,x))) for o,x in zip(d.origin,d.dest)]
 counts=d.route.value_counts(); b=counts[counts==counts.max()].index.tolist()
 x=d[~d.cancelled.astype(bool)].copy()
 def delay(r):
  s=int(r[sc][:2])*60+int(r[sc][3:]); a=int(r[ac][:2])*60+int(r[ac][3:]); z=a-s
  return z+1440 if z < -720 else z-1440 if z>720 else z
 x['del']=x.apply(delay,axis=1)
 g=x.groupby('route').agg(n=('route','size'),bad=('del',lambda z:(z>15).sum())); g['rate']=g.bad/g.n
 e=g[g.n>=20]; m=e.rate.max(); w=e.index[e.rate==m].tolist()
 print(c, 'b',b,'w',w, 'details',e.loc[w].to_dict('index'))
 ans[c]={'busiest':b[0], 'worst':w[0]}
print(ans)

for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 d=pd.read_csv(f); print(os.path.basename(f),d.shape,'duplicate ids',d.flight_id.duplicated().sum(),'cancel',d.cancelled.value_counts().to_dict())
 print(d.columns.tolist())
# calculate with time delta handling columns; dates filter
out={}
for f in glob.glob('airlines/*.csv'):
 car=os.path.basename(f)[:2]; d=pd.read_csv(f)
 d=d.drop_duplicates('flight_id').copy()
 # relevant Jan-Feb; date/date_utc
 datecol='date' if 'date' in d else 'date_utc'
 d[datecol]=pd.to_datetime(d[datecol]); d=d[d[datecol].dt.month.isin([1,2])]
 d['route']=d.apply(lambda r:'-'.join(sorted([r.origin,r.dest])),axis=1)
 # times, actual null cancelled
 sc='sched_dep' if 'sched_dep' in d else 'sched_dep_utc'; ac='actual_dep' if 'actual_dep' in d else 'actual_dep_utc'
 d['delay']=pd.to_timedelta(d[ac].fillna('00:00')+':00')-pd.to_timedelta(d[sc]+':00')
 # if negative huge, midnight rollover: add day when actual clock less sched; cancelled ignored
 d.loc[(~d.cancelled)&(d.delay.dt.total_seconds()<-3600),'delay']+=pd.Timedelta(days=1)
 d['delayed']=(d.delay.dt.total_seconds()/60>15)
 counts=d.groupby('route').size().sort_values(ascending=False)
 comp=d[~d.cancelled].groupby('route').agg(completed=('cancelled','size'), delayed=('delayed','sum'))
 comp['rate']=comp.delayed/comp.completed
 eligible=comp[comp.completed>=20].sort_values(['rate','completed'],ascending=[False,True])
 print('\n',car,'busiest',counts.head(5).to_dict(),'eligible top',eligible.head(8).to_dict('index'))
 out[car]={'busiest':counts.index[0],'worst':eligible.index[0]}
print(out)

events.notes: Loaded each carrier file, handled AS's *_utc column names, canonicalized routes by alphabetically sorting the airport pair, and used January-February dates. Busiest routes were selected by all scheduled records including cancellations. Worst routes were selected by maximum delayed/completed rate among routes with at least 20 completed flights; duplicate B6 records were deduplicated by flight_id as indicated by the data documentation. Delays account for departures crossing midnight.
